p.em: What are the deployable units and how do they communicate?

g.title: Thai payment gateway — credit/debit card processing
TypeScript / Next.js — Flight search, booking form, payment page, my bookings, check-in, boarding passes. Server-side rendered. 12 screens.

Go + Gin, port 9988 — Flight search (public), flight detail, booking CRUD, booking status update (internal). Session auth + internal token guard. Structured logging, correlation IDs, security headers.
Go + Gin, port 9984 — Card charge via Omise, payment receipt lookup. Rate-limited (10 req/s). Session auth. Structured logging, correlation IDs, security headers.
Database for qoomlee-service — flights, routes, passengers, bookings, checkins, boarding_passes tables.
Database for payment-service — payments table. Isolated from qoomlee database.
